conf.description: netflow, options dataset, sflow format: parse sflowtool/hsflowd counter-sample JSON and map the interface counters into the custom sflow.* namespace that enriches the flow dataset's observer.*.interface fields.

conf.comment: netflow / options / sflow. An sFlow counter sample is self-describing (no template/options record to cache) and carries ifIndex plus interface octet/packet/error counters, but NOT interfaceName/interfaceDescription (not on the sFlow wire; SNMP-sourced, added downstream). Every field here is numeric/enum, so it stays in the custom sflow.* namespace as the join/enrichment material for the flow dataset's observer.ingress/egress.interface.id.

functions.description: record what this record type does and does not carry
parse the sflowtool/hsflowd counter-sample JSON line
batch-rename every counter-sample field into the custom sflow.* namespace
tag the dataset and drop the now fully-extracted raw copy
